source: a third-person explorer where you roam a small 3D world and collect gems, playable on mobile and desktop. On mobile use an on-screen virtual thumbstick anchored bottom-left to move the character; the thumbstick should also respond to mouse drag on desktop. DO NOT ASK ANY QUESTIONS JUST COMPLETE

image_prompt.text: Tucked-away pockets behind rocks and foliage where a gem rewards poking around
A board or pillar in the world showing how many gems remain to be found

layout_placement.text: Gems scattered across the small world - on the ground, on rocks, and among foliage
Tracker tied to the gem count so found gems register against the total

notes: The on-screen thumbstick and its mouse-drag behaviour are screen-space input and belong to neither the image nor the layout stream; they are recorded here so they are not lost.
The one layout-relevant part of the mobile requirement is keeping the bottom-left of the frame free of anything the player needs to see.
Theme is unstated. The prompt forbids clarifying questions, so theme is emitted as null for neutral dressing rather than guessed.

open_questions.ask: No visual style was given - should the world be bright and stylized, or naturalistic? (The prompt asked not to be asked, so a neutral dressing is being used.)
